Contractor shall provide Building Official duties, Florida Building Code compliant inspection, plan review, and enforcement, in addition to permit technician services on an as-needed basis (the Services ). Contractor will perform Services in accordance with all applicable codes and ordinances, as well as all amendments thereo, adopted by the elected body of the City, as well as all applicable state and federal regulations.
